context.transcript:
Thank you for coming to today's all-staff meeting.
As the chief production officer, I recently led an audit of our production strategy to ensure that our company stays competitive.
After looking at the results, we are going to be cutting back on the manufacturing of our small electronics so that we can focus on more high-demand goods, like laptops.
This is going to cause a change in our factory operations.
Asako here is going to tell you what your job tasks and responsibilities will be going forward.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢大家参加今天的全体员工会议。
作为首席生产官，我最近领导了一次对我们生产战略的审计，以确保公司保持竞争力。
在查看了结果后，我们将减少小型电子产品的制造，以便专注于更多需求量大的商品，比如笔记本电脑。
这将导致我们的工厂运营发生变化。
Asako 将告诉大家今后你们的工作任务和职责是什么。
